title: High School DxD
source: High School DxD light novels by Ichiei Ishibumi (main series finished; True High School DxD ongoing). Latest published arc. PG-13 only.
world: Kuoh Academy hides a secret: devils, angels and fallen angels live among students. Rias Gremory, a high-class devil and president of the Occult Research Club, revives Issei Hyoudou as her servant, and he carries the Red Dragon Emperor's power. The club grows into a team fighting threats to the three factions and other mythologies. Action comedy with lots of fanservice in canon, which this app leaves out.
power_system: Devils build peerages with Evil Pieces (chess-piece ranks); Rating Games are official devil competitions. Sacred Gears are god-made powers in humans, like Issei's Boosted Gear holding the dragon Ddraig. Rias uses the Power of Destruction.
